description.html: The HabiStat Dial Hygrometer measures air humidity in the terrarium and helps you keep conditions right for your species. The round dial has a colour-coded scale marked dry, moderate and humid, so you can read the value quickly. It works without batteries or cables and measures 5.8 x 1.8 x 5.8 cm.

Correct humidity matters for shedding, breathing and the animal's general condition. Tropical species such as crested geckos and chameleons need more humid air, while desert species do well in a dry terrarium with a humid hide.

HabiStat advises placing the hygrometer halfway between the hot and cold end of the terrarium for an average reading. Do not put it right next to the water bowl or a spot you mist directly, as it will read higher than the rest of the terrarium.

You raise humidity by misting, a damp substrate or a misting system, and lower it with better ventilation. For complete monitoring, use the HabiStat Dial Thermometer alongside the hygrometer. Find other gear in our equipment range.
